name: Je'neu of the Earthen Ring
summary: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Je'neu of the Earthen Ring studies a spreading corruption. Horde travelers bring him a corrupted water globe recovered from Ashenvale's elementals. As a shaman devoted to elemental harmony, he seeks to understand the blight along the Zoram Strand and within Blackfathom Deeps, in hope of halting the poison in the region's waters.

sections.title: A Messenger for the Elements
sections.body: Mastok Wrilehiss sends you to Je'neu Sancrea with a corrupted water globe recovered from Ashenvale's elementals. Strange elementals have surfaced across the region, animated by unnatural power that scouts cannot explain. Among their remains, the intact globe pulses with corrupted magic. Mastok knows soldiers and scouts lack the spiritual insight to understand it, so he directs Horde travelers to someone versed in ancient legends and elemental lore.

sections.title: The Eyes of the Earthen Ring
sections.body: Je'neu Sancrea serves the Earthen Ring, an order of shamans devoted to balance among Azeroth's primal forces. Horde forces guard the Zoram Strand frontier while he studies the spiritual wound in Blackfathom Deeps' nearby temple ruins. To Je'neu, an elemental drawing strength from a tainted vessel is no isolated threat. It is an alarming omen: unseen, ancient powers are perverting the natural order.

faq.answer: Je'neu Sancrea is a troll shaman of the Earthen Ring in northern Kalimdor. He devotes his life to communing with and studying the elements, and stays near the Zoram Strand to investigate dark disturbances rising from Blackfathom Deeps.

The Earthen Ring is an order of shamans devoted to keeping Azeroth's primal elements in harmony. Its members study ancient lore, forgotten spirits, and old legends to mend elemental chaos and heal spiritual corruption across the world.

faq.q: Where can Je'neu Sancrea be found?
faq.answer: Je'neu Sancrea can be found at Zoram'gar Outpost on the coast of the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale. There he studies elemental disturbances rising from nearby Blackfathom Deeps.

faq.q: What is the Befouled Water Globe?
faq.answer: The Befouled Water Globe is a magical conduit through which powerful water elementals channel their strength. Its corrupted, intact state suggests dark forces are deliberately twisting and enslaving the local spirits.

faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Je'neu?
faq.answer: Mastok Wrilehiss, a Horde officer stationed in Ashenvale, directs adventurers to deliver the tainted relic to Je'neu. The army cannot decipher its strange magical nature.

faq.q: What will Je'neu do with the globe?
faq.answer: Je'neu takes custody of the vessel for the Earthen Ring to study its blight. He hopes that study will reveal how to cleanse the waters and restore peace to the region's troubled elementals.

angles.text: As a shaman, you help uphold elemental balance. Delivering the corrupted globe aids a fellow member of the Earthen Ring in diagnosing a dangerous spiritual sickness.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure the Ashenvale coastline by uncovering the dark origins of local elemental hostility near fortified camps such as Zoram'gar Outpost.
As a troll, you can see Je'neu Sancrea's deep spiritual wisdom. He applies his ancestral bond with the spirits in service to the Earthen Ring.
